answer: Every job begins with a kernel: the buyer locks a sum in escrow on the Ledge before work starts, and the claim hangs from that kernel until delivery. The desk reads the buyer's vine of completed escrows and frees the sum only when the buyer confirms delivery within a week; a claim with no locked kernel, or one never confirmed, is rejected and forfeits a 200-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 buyers with real money plus 200,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims with no buyer behind them, and all forty died.
